process_observations: Phase 0 meta-prerequisite design worked: placing EnvGuard repair as unconditioned first experiment (exp1063) broke a 3-milestone SKIP cascade — the downstream chain (1064→1066→1067→1068→1074) all succeeded once the blocker was cleared

Exp1065 revealed a new conductor failure mode: gate_check_failed despite exp1063 having just succeeded — the gate validator appears to re-evaluate test counts after each step, and the post-exp1063 test count change triggered a false negative; WOPR cartridges succeeded anyway, confirming the Codex routing was already functional through a different code path

Infrastructure experiments were extremely fast once environmental blockers cleared: exp1066 (0.571s), exp1067 (2.501s), exp1068 (5s) — the 3-milestone pattern of SKIPs was conductor mechanics overhead, not experiment complexity, confirming that blocker resolution has outsized ROI

FR-11 model tier violation: exp1074 used Qwen3.5-0.8B (CPU smoke-test tier per CLAUDE.md) rather than the required SOTA flagship; the alpha_t=0.78 result is numerically plausible but must be reproduced with Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-GGUF before appearing in the position paper's §3

Triple Integration (exp1073) finally succeeded on the 4th consecutive milestone attempt after gate coercion (exp1067) deployed — confirms the diagnosis from .80 was correct all along; resolving root causes rather than retrying failed experiments remains the highest-value planning strategy
